## Positioning & Core Expertise

Siya Pawar is a Gen-Z UGC creator and lifestyle influencer based in Pune, India. She specializes in creator-direct partnerships with D2C and lifestyle brands, producing high-retention short-form video ads, organic Instagram Reels, aesthetic product photography, and unboxing videos. Her content is characterized by natural daylight, conversational voice-note hooks, and dynamic pacing that drives both organic engagement and high ROAS on paid social campaigns.

## Published Metrics & Reach

- 2M+ peak monthly reach
- 1M+ views on viral reels
- 9K+ engaged community on Instagram
- Proven brand collaborations across healthtech, D2C luggage/accessories, fashion, beauty, and F&B

## Deliverables for Brands

1. Dedicated Instagram Reels (Concept, script, shoot, edit; 5–7 day turnaround)
2. UGC Ad Creatives for Paid Social (Hook variations, product demo bodies, direct CTAs)
3. Instagram Story Sets (Multi-frame product launches and unboxings)
4. Editorial Product Photography (High-resolution still assets for social and website usage)
5. Offline Store Launch & Event Coverage (On-ground coverage in Pune and Mumbai)
6. Monthly Creator Retainers (End-to-end strategy, scripting, production, and posting)
